templates.name: SNMP MPLS LDP
templates.description: Template for monitoring MPLS LDP (Label Distribution Protocol) using SNMP, based on MPLS-LDP-STD-MIB (RFC 3815).

items.name: MPLS LDP LSR Loop Detection Capable
items.description: An indication of whether this Label Switching Router supports loop detection. (mplsLdpLsrLoopDetectionCapable)

items.name: MPLS LDP Entity Last Change
items.description: SysUpTime of the most recent add/delete or change to mplsLdpEntityTable. (mplsLdpEntityLastChange)

items.name: MPLS LDP Entity Index Next
items.description: Appropriate value for mplsLdpEntityIndex when creating entries. 0 means no unassigned entries. (mplsLdpEntityIndexNext)

items.name: MPLS LDP Peer Last Change
items.description: SysUpTime of the most recent add/delete to mplsLdpPeerTable/mplsLdpSessionTable. (mplsLdpPeerLastChange)

items.name: MPLS FEC Last Change
items.description: SysUpTime of the most recent add/delete or change to mplsLdpFecTable. (mplsFecLastChange)

items.name: MPLS FEC Index Next
items.description: Appropriate value for mplsFecIndex when creating entries. 0 means no unassigned entries. (mplsFecIndexNext)

items.name: MPLS LDP LSP FEC Last Change
items.description: SysUpTime of the most recent add/delete or change to mplsLdpLspFecTable. (mplsLdpLspFecLastChange)

discovery_rules.name: MPLS LDP Entities
discovery_rules.description: Discovery of MPLS LDP Entities (mplsLdpEntityTable) and their statistics (mplsLdpEntityStatsTable). {#SNMPENTITYKEY} is the combined LDP ID and Entity Index.

item_prototypes.name: LDP Entity [{#SNMPENTITYKEY}]: LDP ID
item_prototypes.description: The LDP identifier for entity represented by mplsLdpEntityIndex {#SNMPENTITYKEY}. (mplsLdpEntityLdpId)

item_prototypes.name: LDP Entity [{#SNMPENTITYKEY}]: Protocol Version
item_prototypes.description: LDP protocol version for entity {#SNMPENTITYKEY}. (mplsLdpEntityProtocolVersion)

item_prototypes.name: LDP Entity [{#SNMPENTITYKEY}]: Admin Status
item_prototypes.description: Administrative status of LDP Entity {#SNMPENTITYKEY}. (mplsLdpEntityAdminStatus)

item_prototypes.name: LDP Entity [{#SNMPENTITYKEY}]: Operational Status
item_prototypes.description: Operational status of LDP Entity {#SNMPENTITYKEY}. (mplsLdpEntityOperStatus)

item_prototypes.name: LDP Entity [{#SNMPENTITYKEY}]: TCP Port
item_prototypes.description: LDP TCP Port for entity {#SNMPENTITYKEY}. (mplsLdpEntityTcpPort)

item_prototypes.name: LDP Entity [{#SNMPENTITYKEY}]: UDP Discovery Port
item_prototypes.description: LDP UDP Discovery Port for entity {#SNMPENTITYKEY}. (mplsLdpEntityUdpDscPort)

item_prototypes.name: LDP Entity [{#SNMPENTITYKEY}]: Max PDU Length
item_prototypes.description: Max PDU Length sent in Initialization Message for entity {#SNMPENTITYKEY}. (mplsLdpEntityMaxPduLength)

item_prototypes.name: LDP Entity [{#SNMPENTITYKEY}]: KeepAlive Hold Timer
item_prototypes.description: Proposed KeepAlive Hold Timer for entity {#SNMPENTITYKEY}. (mplsLdpEntityKeepAliveHoldTimer)

item_prototypes.name: LDP Entity [{#SNMPENTITYKEY}]: Hello Hold Timer
item_prototypes.description: Proposed Hello Hold Timer for entity {#SNMPENTITYKEY}. (mplsLdpEntityHelloHoldTimer)

item_prototypes.name: LDP Entity [{#SNMPENTITYKEY}]: Init Session Threshold
item_prototypes.description: Threshold for mplsLdpInitSessionThresholdExceeded notification for entity {#SNMPENTITYKEY}. (mplsLdpEntityInitSessionThreshold)

item_prototypes.name: LDP Entity [{#SNMPENTITYKEY}]: Label Distribution Method
item_prototypes.description: Label distribution method for entity {#SNMPENTITYKEY}. (mplsLdpEntityLabelDistMethod)

item_prototypes.name: LDP Entity [{#SNMPENTITYKEY}]: Label Retention Mode
item_prototypes.description: Label retention mode for entity {#SNMPENTITYKEY}. (mplsLdpEntityLabelRetentionMode)

item_prototypes.name: LDP Entity [{#SNMPENTITYKEY}]: Path Vector Limit
item_prototypes.description: Path Vector Limit for loop detection for entity {#SNMPENTITYKEY}. (mplsLdpEntityPathVectorLimit)

item_prototypes.name: LDP Entity [{#SNMPENTITYKEY}]: Hop Count Limit
item_prototypes.description: Hop Count Limit for loop detection for entity {#SNMPENTITYKEY}. (mplsLdpEntityHopCountLimit)

item_prototypes.name: LDP Entity [{#SNMPENTITYKEY}]: Transport Address Kind
item_prototypes.description: Transport address kind (interface/loopback) for Hello messages for entity {#SNMPENTITYKEY}. (mplsLdpEntityTransportAddrKind)

item_prototypes.name: LDP Entity [{#SNMPENTITYKEY}]: Targeted Peer
item_prototypes.description: Whether LDP entity {#SNMPENTITYKEY} uses a targeted peer (true/false). (mplsLdpEntityTargetPeer)

item_prototypes.name: LDP Entity [{#SNMPENTITYKEY}]: Target Peer Addr Type
item_prototypes.description: Address type for Extended Discovery target peer for entity {#SNMPENTITYKEY}. (mplsLdpEntityTargetPeerAddrType)

item_prototypes.name: LDP Entity [{#SNMPENTITYKEY}]: Target Peer Addr
item_prototypes.description: Address for Extended Discovery target peer for entity {#SNMPENTITYKEY}. (mplsLdpEntityTargetPeerAddr)

item_prototypes.name: LDP Entity [{#SNMPENTITYKEY}]: Label Type
item_prototypes.description: Optional parameters for LDP Initialization Message for entity {#SNMPENTITYKEY}. (mplsLdpEntityLabelType)

item_prototypes.name: LDP Entity [{#SNMPENTITYKEY}]: Discontinuity Time
item_prototypes.description: SysUpTime of the most recent counter discontinuity for entity {#SNMPENTITYKEY}. (mplsLdpEntityDiscontinuityTime)

item_prototypes.name: LDP Entity Stats [{#SNMPENTITYKEY}]: Session Attempts
item_prototypes.description: Rate of failed session initializations for entity {#SNMPENTITYKEY}. (mplsLdpEntityStatsSessionAttempts)

item_prototypes.name: LDP Entity Stats [{#SNMPENTITYKEY}]: Session Rejected No Hello Errors
item_prototypes.description: Rate of Session Rejected/No Hello Error Notifications for entity {#SNMPENTITYKEY}. (mplsLdpEntityStatsSessionRejectedNoHelloErrors)

item_prototypes.name: LDP Entity Stats [{#SNMPENTITYKEY}]: SessionRejectedAd Errors
item_prototypes.description: Rate of SessionRejectedAd Errors for entity {#SNMPENTITYKEY}. (mplsLdpEntityStatsSessionRejectedAdErrors)

item_prototypes.name: LDP Entity Stats [{#SNMPENTITYKEY}]: SessionRejectedMaxPdu Errors
item_prototypes.description: Rate of SessionRejectedMaxPdu Errors for entity {#SNMPENTITYKEY}. (mplsLdpEntityStatsSessionRejectedMaxPduErrors)

item_prototypes.name: LDP Entity Stats [{#SNMPENTITYKEY}]: SessionRejectedLR Errors
item_prototypes.description: Rate of SessionRejectedLR Errors for entity {#SNMPENTITYKEY}. (mplsLdpEntityStatsSessionRejectedLRErrors)

item_prototypes.name: LDP Entity Stats [{#SNMPENTITYKEY}]: BadLdpIdentifier Errors
item_prototypes.description: Rate of BadLdpIdentifier Errors for entity {#SNMPENTITYKEY}. (mplsLdpEntityStatsBadLdpIdentifierErrors)

item_prototypes.name: LDP Entity Stats [{#SNMPENTITYKEY}]: BadPduLength Errors
item_prototypes.description: Rate of BadPduLength Errors for entity {#SNMPENTITYKEY}. (mplsLdpEntityStatsBadPduLengthErrors)

item_prototypes.name: LDP Entity Stats [{#SNMPENTITYKEY}]: BadMessageLength Errors
item_prototypes.description: Rate of BadMessageLength Errors for entity {#SNMPENTITYKEY}. (mplsLdpEntityStatsBadMessageLengthErrors)

item_prototypes.name: LDP Entity Stats [{#SNMPENTITYKEY}]: BadTlvLength Errors
item_prototypes.description: Rate of BadTlvLength Errors for entity {#SNMPENTITYKEY}. (mplsLdpEntityStatsBadTlvLengthErrors)

item_prototypes.name: LDP Entity Stats [{#SNMPENTITYKEY}]: MalformedTlvValue Errors
item_prototypes.description: Rate of MalformedTlvValue Errors for entity {#SNMPENTITYKEY}. (mplsLdpEntityStatsMalformedTlvValueErrors)

item_prototypes.name: LDP Entity Stats [{#SNMPENTITYKEY}]: KeepAliveTimerExp Errors
item_prototypes.description: Rate of KeepAliveTimerExp Errors for entity {#SNMPENTITYKEY}. (mplsLdpEntityStatsKeepAliveTimerExpErrors)

item_prototypes.name: LDP Entity Stats [{#SNMPENTITYKEY}]: ShutdownReceived Notifications
item_prototypes.description: Rate of ShutdownReceived Notifications for entity {#SNMPENTITYKEY}. (mplsLdpEntityStatsShutdownReceivedNotifications)

item_prototypes.name: LDP Entity Stats [{#SNMPENTITYKEY}]: ShutdownSent Notifications
item_prototypes.description: Rate of ShutdownSent Notifications for entity {#SNMPENTITYKEY}. (mplsLdpEntityStatsShutdownSentNotifications)

trigger_prototypes.name: MPLS LDP Entity [{#SNMPENTITYKEY}] Operational Status is not Enabled
trigger_prototypes.description: MPLS LDP Entity with key {#SNMPENTITYKEY} operational status is not 'enabled(2)'. Current state: {{ITEM.LASTVALUE}}.

discovery_rules.name: MPLS LDP Sessions
discovery_rules.description: Discovery of MPLS LDP Peers (mplsLdpPeerTable), Sessions (mplsLdpSessionTable), and their statistics (mplsLdpSessionStatsTable). {#LDPSESSIONKEY} is EntityLdpId.EntityIndex.PeerLdpId.

item_prototypes.name: LDP Session Peer [{#LDPSESSIONKEY}]: Label Dist Method
item_prototypes.description: Label distribution method for LDP Peer in session {#LDPSESSIONKEY}. (mplsLdpPeerLabelDistMethod)

item_prototypes.name: LDP Session Peer [{#LDPSESSIONKEY}]: Path Vector Limit
item_prototypes.description: Path Vector Limit for loop detection for Peer in session {#LDPSESSIONKEY}. (mplsLdpPeerPathVectorLimit)

item_prototypes.name: LDP Session Peer [{#LDPSESSIONKEY}]: Transport Addr Type
item_prototypes.description: Transport address type for Peer in session {#LDPSESSIONKEY}. (mplsLdpPeerTransportAddrType)

item_prototypes.name: LDP Session Peer [{#LDPSESSIONKEY}]: Transport Addr
item_prototypes.description: Transport address for Peer in session {#LDPSESSIONKEY}. (mplsLdpPeerTransportAddr)

item_prototypes.name: LDP Session [{#LDPSESSIONKEY}]: State Last Change
item_prototypes.description: SysUpTime of last state change for session {#LDPSESSIONKEY}. (mplsLdpSessionStateLastChange)

item_prototypes.name: LDP Session [{#LDPSESSIONKEY}]: State
item_prototypes.description: Current state of LDP session {#LDPSESSIONKEY}. (mplsLdpSessionState)

item_prototypes.name: LDP Session [{#LDPSESSIONKEY}]: Role
item_prototypes.description: Role (active/passive) of this LSR/LER in session {#LDPSESSIONKEY} establishment. (mplsLdpSessionRole)

item_prototypes.name: LDP Session [{#LDPSESSIONKEY}]: Protocol Version
item_prototypes.description: Negotiated LDP protocol version for session {#LDPSESSIONKEY}. (mplsLdpSessionProtocolVersion)

item_prototypes.name: LDP Session [{#LDPSESSIONKEY}]: KeepAlive Hold Time Remaining
item_prototypes.description: KeepAlive hold time remaining for session {#LDPSESSIONKEY}. (mplsLdpSessionKeepAliveHoldTimeRem)

item_prototypes.name: LDP Session [{#LDPSESSIONKEY}]: KeepAlive Time
item_prototypes.description: Negotiated KeepAlive Time for session {#LDPSESSIONKEY}. (mplsLdpSessionKeepAliveTime)

item_prototypes.name: LDP Session [{#LDPSESSIONKEY}]: Max PDU Length
item_prototypes.description: Negotiated Max PDU Length for session {#LDPSESSIONKEY}. (mplsLdpSessionMaxPduLength)

item_prototypes.name: LDP Session [{#LDPSESSIONKEY}]: Discontinuity Time
item_prototypes.description: SysUpTime of most recent counter discontinuity for session {#LDPSESSIONKEY}. (mplsLdpSessionDiscontinuityTime)

item_prototypes.name: LDP Session Stats [{#LDPSESSIONKEY}]: Unknown Message Type Errors
item_prototypes.description: Rate of Unknown Message Type Errors for session {#LDPSESSIONKEY}. (mplsLdpSessionStatsUnknownMesTypeErrors)

item_prototypes.name: LDP Session Stats [{#LDPSESSIONKEY}]: Unknown TLV Errors
item_prototypes.description: Rate of Unknown TLV Errors for session {#LDPSESSIONKEY}. (mplsLdpSessionStatsUnknownTlvErrors)

trigger_prototypes.name: MPLS LDP Session [{#LDPSESSIONKEY}] is not Operational
trigger_prototypes.description: MPLS LDP Session with key {#LDPSESSIONKEY} is not 'operational(5)'. Current state: {{ITEM.LASTVALUE}}.

discovery_rules.name: MPLS LDP Hello Adjacencies
discovery_rules.description: Discovery of MPLS LDP Hello Adjacencies (mplsLdpHelloAdjacencyTable). {#LDPHELLOADJKEY} is EntityLdpId.EntityIndex.PeerLdpId.HelloAdjacencyIndex.

item_prototypes.name: LDP Hello Adjacency [{#LDPHELLOADJKEY}]: Hold Time Remaining
item_prototypes.description: Time remaining for this Hello Adjacency [{#LDPHELLOADJKEY}] to receive its next Hello Message. (mplsLdpHelloAdjacencyHoldTimeRem)

item_prototypes.name: LDP Hello Adjacency [{#LDPHELLOADJKEY}]: Hold Time
item_prototypes.description: Negotiated Hello hold time for adjacency {#LDPHELLOADJKEY}. 0 means default (15s Link, 45s Targeted), 65535 infinite. (mplsLdpHelloAdjacencyHoldTime)

item_prototypes.name: LDP Hello Adjacency [{#LDPHELLOADJKEY}]: Type
item_prototypes.description: Type of Hello Adjacency (link or targeted) for {#LDPHELLOADJKEY}. (mplsLdpHelloAdjacencyType)
